name: Previous Candle Breakdown 2
summary: This EA implements a previous candle breakout strategy, entering long when price breaks above the previous candle's high and short when it breaks below the previous candle's low. It is a systematic breakout system that trades on the assumption that momentum from a prior candle's range violation will continue. The strategy typically includes stop-loss and take-profit levels based on the candle range or fixed values.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了前一根K线突破策略,当价格突破前一根K线最高价时做多,突破最低价时做空。这是一个系统化的突破交易系统,基于前一根K线范围被突破后动量延续的假设进行交易。策略通常包含基于K线幅度或固定值的止损和止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于前一根K线的突破交易,当价格突破前一根K线的最高价时开多单,突破最低价时开空单。入场条件为当前价格突破前一根已完成K线的高点或低点,属于经典的突破入场方式。出场条件通常设置固定止盈止损,或使用前一根K线的幅度来动态计算目标位。仓位管理一般采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数。资金管理方面,该策略可能包含最大持仓限制和最大回撤控制,但具体取决于参数配置。该策略的核心风险在于假突破导致的频繁亏损,以及震荡行情中反复被止损的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trading breakouts of the previous candle, going long when price breaks above the prior candle's high and short when it breaks below the low. Entry conditions are straightforward: a trade is triggered when the current price violates the high or low of the most recently completed candle, which is a classic breakout entry method. Exit conditions typically use fixed take-profit and stop-loss values, or dynamically calculate targets based on the previous candle's range. Position sizing generally employs either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based lot calculation derived from account balance. Money management may include maximum position limits and drawdown controls, though specifics depend on parameter configuration. The core risk of this strategy lies in false breakouts causing frequent losses, and the problem of repeated stop-outs during ranging or choppy market conditions.

parameters.description: EA魔术编号,用于区分订单

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰,易于理解和验证
突破策略在趋势行情中有较好的盈利表现
入场条件明确,不含模糊的主观判断
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
Breakout strategies perform well in trending markets with good profitability
Entry conditions are well-defined without ambiguous subjective judgment
cons: 假突破会导致频繁止损,尤其在震荡行情中
缺乏趋势过滤器,可能在横盘市场中反复亏损
单一K线突破信号可靠性较低,容易受市场噪音影响
cons_en: False breakouts cause frequent stop-losses, especially in ranging markets
Lacks a trend filter, may suffer repeated losses in sideways markets
Single candle breakout signal has low reliability and is susceptible to market noise
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器(如均线方向或ADX)以避免在震荡行情中交易
加入成交量确认或多次突破验证以提高信号质量
实现动态止损和移动止盈以更好地锁定利润
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX) to avoid trading in ranging markets
Incorporate volume confirmation or multi-breakout verification to improve signal quality
Implement dynamic stop-loss and trailing take-profit to better lock in profits

risk_points: 假突破风险:单一K线突破信号可能产生大量虚假信号
缺乏市场状态过滤:在震荡市和趋势市中使用相同参数可能导致不适配
可能缺少新K线检查:同一根K线内可能重复开仓
risk_points_en: False breakout risk: single candle breakout signals may generate many false signals
Lacks market regime filter: using the same parameters in ranging and trending markets may cause mismatch
May lack new bar check: could open duplicate positions within the same candle
